All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations redlined (6)**
- **LOL-CAP** — cap is sliced to fees for the single "transaction" at issue and only Section 8 indemnities are carved out; restored a full 12-month fee cap and added an Excluded Claims sentence (confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud).
- **T4C** — five-year term with breach-only exits; added a 30-day convenience right with pro-rata refund.
- **IP** — Section 13.5 transfers our Developments to Commerce One wherever it supports them; deleted the reversal so what we build stays ours.
- **WARRANTY** — 60 days from Effective Date with a 31 Dec 1999 cut-off; extended to 90 days from acceptance.
- **INSURANCE** — no insurance covenant at all; inserted CGL/E&O/cyber at fallback levels.
- **TRANSITION** — no data return or exit assistance for the hosted MarketSite.net Service; inserted a transition/data-return paragraph.

**Compliant (12)** — INDEMN (uncapped Vendor IP indemnity extending to our Customers), RENEWAL (12-month renewals, 30-day window), GOVLAW (California law/AAA in San Francisco — fallback), ASSIGN (mutual M&A carve-out, no change-of-control exit), LICENSE (perpetual, irrevocable, sublicensable), AUDIT (annual, independent CPA, Vendor cost), plus NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, NOSOLICIT, LD and MINCOMMIT, none of which appear in burdensome form.
